name: living-stack-community
description: Free seven-tool proof loop for scoped authorization, outcome receipts, and evidence-bound claims.
long_description: Living Stack Community proves one complete local evidence loop without shipping the paid implementation. It opens scoped sessions, applies budget and risk gates, issues one-use action authorizations, records typed evidence, checks claims against exact successful outcomes and subjects, and preserves a tamper-evident local ledger.

tools.name: livingstack.status
tools.description: Inspect Community capabilities and the paid boundary.

tools.name: livingstack.session_start
tools.description: Start an isolated proof session with immutable scope and budget.

tools.name: livingstack.session_status
tools.description: Verify a session lifecycle, budget, counts, and ledger head.

tools.name: livingstack.authorize_action
tools.description: Gate one local host action against risk and budget without executing it.

tools.name: livingstack.record_outcome
tools.description: Consume one authorization and bind its observed result to typed evidence.

tools.name: livingstack.check_claim
tools.description: Check a proposed claim against selected, fresh, successful, subject-bound evidence.

tools.name: livingstack.session_close
tools.description: Close the proof session and preserve its tamper-evident local ledger.
